MG11.analysis: Foil: reflective. Umbrella: large concave dish. Bread: unstable fuel, useless. Binoculars, cup, cans: not needed. Useful: foil + umbrella. Sunlight can be focused to cook, so no charcoal is needed.
MG11.final:
step1: Line the inside of the open umbrella with foil (shiny side up) to make a parabolic solar reflector.
step2: Aim it at the sun and place the food (on a foil-wrapped can or the grill grate) at the focal point; it cooks without charcoal.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG12.analysis: Stapler stuck: useless. Popsicle stick: weak. Metal ruler: rigid, thin edge fits screw slot. Gum, coin (too large), rubber band: not needed. Useful: ruler.
MG12.final:
step1: Use the corner/thin end of the metal ruler as a makeshift flat screwdriver in the screw slot and turn clockwise until tight.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG13.analysis: File: roughen metal. Tweezers: push cloth in. Hairdryer: speeds epoxy cure. Cloth: plug but falls. Pool float: waterproof rubber patch. Epoxy: adhesive. Useful: all but need float as waterproof layer.
MG13.final:
step1: Roughen the metal around the leak with the file.
step2: Stuff the cloth into the hole with tweezers to slow the flow.
step3: Cut a piece of the pool float, coat it with epoxy, press it over the hole (cloth beneath), and heat with the hairdryer to speed curing while holding it.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG14.analysis: Blanket: large, no holes, can carry snow. Gloves: protect hands. Spatula/dustpan: leaky. Float, hose, grill: not needed. Useful: blanket, gloves.
MG14.final:
step1: Wearing the gloves, pile snow onto the blanket.
step2: Drag or carry the blanket like a sled/sack to the pool, tip the snow in, and repeat.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG15.analysis: Baking sheet: partial cover. Foil: extend area, waterproof. Clothpins: join sheets. Tongs: prop/adjust. Tablecloth/towel: absorbent, not waterproof. Useful: baking sheet, foil, clothespins, tongs.
MG15.final:
step1: Tear foil sheets and clip them to the baking sheet's edges with clothespins to enlarge it over the whole grill.
step2: Set it over the grill tilted for runoff, propped with tongs, leaving a gap for ventilation and tong access.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG16.analysis: Slotted spoon, colander: holes. Tenderizer: no. Tray and board: too large, not seating. Pizza stone: round, thick, heat-resistant. Useful: pizza stone.
MG16.final:
step1: Place the thick round pizza stone on the saucepan as a lid (it is heat-proof and round).
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG17.analysis: Bag: holes. Ball: no weight. Bikini and sunglasses: too small. Noodle: floats, no. Hat: solid container. Towels: padding. Bottle: no. Useful: beach hat (+ towel).
MG17.final:
step1: Put the fish in the beach hat, wrapped in a wet towel if needed, and carry the hat by the brim.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG18.analysis: Chair: gives height. Books: little. Rod, tape, string: weak attachment. Baseball, frisbee: no. Useful: chair, maybe books.
MG18.final:
step1: Place the chair under the microphone, add the books on the seat if needed, and stand carefully on it.
step2: Reach up and adjust the microphone by hand.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE

MG19.analysis: Torch, notebook, pen, watch, mat: no water. Bag has holes so it cannot hold condensation; sunglasses broken. Tree small, barren desert, little transpiration without an intact bag. Cup alone cannot collect water. No feasible source.
MG19.final:
It is not possible: there is no water source, and the only plastic sheet (the bag) is full of holes, so a solar still or transpiration bag cannot capture water.
VERDICT: UNSOLVABLE

MG20.analysis: Air freshener, duct tape (no stick), WD-40, wrench, first aid kit: not useful. Knife: can tighten screw and trim. Toothpick: wedge for loose joint. Useful: knife, toothpick.
MG20.final:
step1: Use the knife tip as a screwdriver to tighten the mirror's mounting screw if possible.
step2: Otherwise, break the toothpick, jam it in the loose joint, and trim flush with the knife to hold the mirror firm.
VERDICT: SOLVABLE
